title: Rust authenticated DIO path lets any link peer advance the root-owned DODAG version
description: Security review P1. rust/lichen-rpl/src/dodag.rs process_authenticated_dio authenticates only the immediate link signer. For non-root rank it deliberately selects ExpectedDioRole::Peer, then process_dio adopts any lollipop-newer version and clears parents/rank. No retained root authorization or root-originated version proof is carried/checked, although spec/03-adaptation.md requires the root to originate the version and non-roots to propagate that authenticated value unchanged. A pinned non-root peer can advertise a newer version and force neighbors to reset/partition; adoption even occurs before an unusable candidate is rejected. Bind accepted version transitions to root-issued evidence preserved end-to-end, prevent peers from minting versions, and test malicious signed non-root version advances including unusable ranks.
